subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should OpenClaw accept the broad 600s unset QMD embed default based on the current grep/test proof, or require real QMD/GGUF runtime proof or a narrower timeout strategy before merge?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes upgrade behavior and lock timing for every existing unset QMD semantic configuration; automation cannot decide whether the current proof is enough for that product/default tradeoff.

options.title: Require runtime proof or override
options.body: Before merge, require redacted real QMD/GGUF logs or a linked artifact showing an unset 600s embed completing, unless a maintainer explicitly records a proof override and default-risk acceptance.

options.title: Accept broad default knowingly
options.body: Maintainership can intentionally merge the 600s default after accepting longer CPU and lock-wait behavior for all unset QMD semantic users.

options.title: Narrow the strategy
options.body: Pause this PR and pursue selective local-GGUF detection, warning/docs-only guidance, or another opt-in path instead of changing every unset QMD config.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof or override
recommendation.body: Before merge, require redacted real QMD/GGUF logs or a linked artifact showing an unset 600s embed completing, unless a maintainer explicitly records a proof override and default-risk acceptance.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee and has recent commits on the same QMD config/default surface.
